# Which roles answer a hover and a selected tab?

Read this when your style plugin answers what a row takes under the pointer or what marks the selected tab.

Both roles on this page are colour roles, so an answer is a palette colour as a `{color.*}` alias or another colour role. `edge-tab-selected` carries a default, and [`style-kernel.md`](../../style-kernel.md#where-the-appearance-actually-comes-from) says what a silent plugin keeps there.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Your markup and Arena's components both read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--edge-tab-selected` | What colour is the rule that marks the selected tab? | color | none | `{color.primary}` |
| `--fill-hover` | What colour does a table row, link card or navigation row take under the pointer? | color | none | none |

<!-- @tree end -->
